correctness.rationale: Both the frozen proof and the narrowed kinetic theorem are correct on the stated stationary common-sign model. Conditional parity is a product of cosines. Its Walsh reconstruction and the symmetric telegraph ODE with initial derivative zero give the precise modes. Subtracting the clean Cesàro law removes exactly the constant modes. For the lower rate bound a Walsh support attaining the minimum nonzero magnitude gives positive slow-pole coefficients in the overdamped case, a positive critical t term, or a nonzero trigonometric polynomial with positive time-averaged square in the underdamped case. Its magnitude is bounded by twice total variation, which yields the matching limsup. The mode at epsilon has weight 1/4 in the triple moment and no competitor of the same size in any other moment; multiplying the scalar slow-pole coefficient by 1/8 gives the stated prefactor. Independent Poisson/Dirichlet path quadrature agreed with the finite-time law at 22 site probabilities, including a critical and a detuned case.
residual_risks: Oscillatory pointwise cancellations can occur; the sharp rate is a logarithmic limsup. Finite numeric quadrature is separate corroboration, not proof. No claim for a completely mixed density matrix or individual paths.

originality.rationale: The frozen originality decision is FAIL as written: its headline equilibrium classification is mathematically covered once the clean-average equivalence is made, including the (1,2,3) static parity illustration as a substitution into the known profile. This is demonstrated coverage, not a priority inference from catalogue dates or a failure of correctness. The repaired finding explicitly credits the endpoint and no longer advances it as an original classification. The repaired PASS is for the common-clock sharp total-variation kinetics (including noncancellation in all switching regimes), the unique optimizing switching rate, and the explicit detuned total-variation equivalent. Those are not given by the prior clean Cesàro law or the single-frequency telegraph formula alone.
residual_risks: A more general published scalar-clock spectral relaxation theorem could give a closer implication. Bounded statement-level search does not establish absolute priority.

value.rationale: For the repaired finding, the exact exponent turns the signed arithmetic into a dynamical observable, identifying arbitrarily slow mixing even when the eventual law is exactly uniform. It gives both a principled switching-rate choice and an explicit asymptotic TV amplitude rather than just the relaxation time of a scalar coherence.
